stories.title: Waymo issues recalls to fix its highway problems.
stories.summary:
Waymo is rolling out two software recalls across its fleet of 3,871 robotaxis. The updates will stop the vehicles from entering closed highway construction zones and improve how they respond to police and emergency crews directing traffic. The move follows several incidents involving construction breaches and ignored officer signals, which recently prompted California to ban Waymo from freeways and forced the company to pause highway operations nationwide.

stories.title: Stupid Never Dies - Official Final Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: Meet the final boss and watch as Davy takes on KOM (King of Monsters) in this final trailer for Stupid Never Dies, the pop-punk saturated action RPG. Stupid Never Dies is available now on PC via Steam and PlayStation 5 (PS5).Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life. Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat.

stories.title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Update Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: A content update for 1666: Amsterdam brings an expansion of the game's world, story, and supernatural abilities. Watch the latest 1666: Amsterdam trailer to see what's coming in the update for the action-adventure game, including a new story mission, new potions, new spells, and more. 1666: Amsterdam is available now in Early Access on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, and the update arrives in December.In the update, you will be able to explore Ouderkerk, a new region slightly larger than the game's currently available area, effectively doubling the world players can explore. Alongside this new location comes another Esbat and a new Original, bringing the next chapter of Noa's journey to Early Access.The update will also introduce additional Lux and Nux spells and combos, along with new jewels and potions, giving players more ways to develop their abilities and approach encounters.
